rounds.text: Dhampur Sugar Mills Ltd trades at an attractive P/E ratio of 14.2x [E1] and a discounted P/B ratio of 0.77x [E2], representing a clear valuation discount compared to broader sector benchmarks of 20.1x P/E and 1.03x P/B [E6, E7]. Furthermore, the company exhibits strong operational efficiency, evidenced by an outstanding cash conversion ratio of 3.80x and free cash flow of Rs 214 Cr in March 2026 [E34, E36], with profits fully backed by cash [E34] and operating cash flow reaching 150% of operating profit [E37]. Fundamental momentum is also visibly turning a corner, as demonstrated by a robust 28% trailing twelve-month profit growth [E21], expanding quarterly operating margins reaching 17% in March 2026 [E31], and rising promoter stakes reaching 49.86% [E42]. Technically, the stock demonstrates solid relative strength at 69 [E52] and trades cleanly above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E51]. Conceded: the business has delivered a poor sales growth of -1.84% over the past five years [E61] alongside a low recent return on equity of 5% [E29].
